security.md: Start with data minimization, then follow session identity, local key custody, transport trust and server-verified evidence.
security/privacy-gdpr-data-residency.md: The server completes an account-deletion workflow while a phone remains offline with old rows and queued uploads. A push hint cannot establish that the phone erased its copy or stopped a later replay.
security/privacy-sandbox.md: A roadmap relies on an advertising API whose official lifecycle status changes before the app ships. The architectural ideas remain useful, but the release plan now needs an exit path.
security/auth-on-mobile.md: A refresh is already in flight when the user signs out. Its successful response arrives later. Saving that response into a generic current-token slot can bring the old session back.
security/secure-storage-on-android.md: A backup restores an encrypted token file onto a device without the key that encrypted it. Generating a fresh key with the same alias cannot decrypt the old ciphertext.
security/key-management.md: The build hides a vendor credential in generated code. The installed APK still has everything needed to use it. Moving the string into another client-side file changes its location, not its owner.
security/certificate-pinning.md: A server certificate rotates successfully, yet an older installed app loses every connection. The trust chain is valid; the app’s extra pin restriction is now the failure boundary.
security/attestation.md: The backend receives a genuine-looking device verdict beside a different action than the token was requested for. A positive device signal cannot establish that these parameters belong to this piece of evidence.
